name: Momiji
message: 「Yaaawn... I slept well~」
Usually Setsugekka would be the one to kick me out of bed, but today I woke up before that could happen.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I can’t exactly be late for this, can I.」
A few days have passed since the first match of the main tournament—
Today is the Martial Festival semi-finals.

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, look at that line, it's huge~」
At the back of the arena, a line of spectators waiting to enter had already formed. There were even broadcast crews filming the scene.
I stayed hidden while heading toward the back entrance so I wouldn't get into any trouble by being spotted.

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew, stealth mission accomplished.」
I managed to reach the entrance without anyone catching sight of me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, morning, Momimomi!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, you’re already here, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yup! I got here first to get all fired up!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Does that mean if I had overslept, you weren't planning on coming to wake me up?」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're heartless, Secchan~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way, wake yourself up on match day！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Though, if you were late, I think that’d actually be pretty funny.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「‘Suzakuin’s eldest daughter misses match due to oversleeping and forfeits！’」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If that were plastered on the front page of a sports paper... pfft, that’d be a masterpiece~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stop it！ That’s not even funny！」
I got goosebumps just imagining it.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa... why was I even born into the Suzakuin family? In that regard, it must be nice being as carefree as you, Setsugekka~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Carefree?! Not a chance~!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My opponent today is Victoria-senpai, you know. Compared to me, you’ve got it way easier, Momimomi！」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, no, Asahi is plenty strong too.」
For the semi―finals―my opponent is Asahi, and Setsugekka’s is Victoria.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...If I win this, I get to fight you, Momimomi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that’s right.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, winning against Momimomi makes me Toujinegi, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m not letting you win, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, don’t you come crying to me after you lose~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, right back at you, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehehe.」
The two of them share a laugh.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...A little while ago, I talked about that with Kei-chan.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm？」
Setsugekka’s voice is strangely solemn.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I asked Kei-chan to turn down the head of the house’s request. So that you wouldn't have to go overseas.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And I also asked her if the teacher could keep running ‘errands’ until we graduate.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And you know what? She said she’d figure something out！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...O-oh, is that so.」
I was taken aback for a moment, never having expected that Keisetsu would agree.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We did it, Momimomi! Our wish is actually going to come true!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Though, of course, that’s all conditional on me actually becoming the Toujinegi~」
A variety of emotions well up within me in an instant.
Conflict, hesitation, irritation, sadness... and then, resignation.
Continuing this life together with everyone just as it is. That is what I want, too.
If I could, I would grant that wish for her.
...But that is impossible. The Suzakuin have their own circumstances, and I have mine.
And so, this is the only thing I can say.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I hope you make it, Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, but hey, Momimomi, don’t you worry about it. These are just my own selfish circumstances.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I fully intend to win, of course, but I imagine you feel the same way.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Win or lose, Momimomi, we’re still friends！ That’s never going to change.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I wonder if things will really go that smoothly……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ So what, are you saying that if I win, you’re going to stop being my friend？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, I’m not saying that. Besides, I’m the one who’s going to win.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You don’t know that until you actually try, you know!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Let me ask you this, then……」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I win, will you still be my friend, Setsugekka？」
Her hesitation showing through more than usual.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, um, I mean……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course I would！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Did you really think I’m the kind of petty person who’d say, ‘If you lose the match, I won’t be friends with you anymore’？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah, I’m disappointed！ Momimomi, you really think too little of me！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Look, in the world of heroes, even if the opponent is a wicked villain, they reach out a hand after defeating them and turn them into an ally.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Defeated enemies become allies！ That’s the classic trope, right！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why are you assuming I’m going to be the one defeated？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, because I’m the ‘I’m totally gonna crush Suzakuin’ person.」
It’s no use…… Her way of thinking is so out there, I can’t keep up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, win or lose, no hard feelings！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don’t you dare pity me and go easy on me, got it!」

name: Momiji
message: 「I won’t, I won’t.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And so, I’m going to beat a full-power Momimomi！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it’s fine to be motivated, but there’s something you need to do before that, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh? Did I have something to do?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, you need to beat Victoria. If you lose, it’s over right here.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Waaaaah! I wonder if I can really win against senpai... What am I going to do if I lose？!」
Setsugekka begins to writhe while clutching her head.

name: Momiji
message: 「Pfft... what are you even doing.」
Suppressing her laughter, she repeats what Setsugekka had just said.

name: Momiji
message: （Friends whether you win or lose, huh...）
Back when I was little, there were many kids I enjoyed practicing Jindou with. At first, they all called me their friend.
But as I started to improve my skills, they drifted away one by one.
That’s why I stopped believing in it.
Believing that it’s impossible for swordsmen to stay friends.

name: Momiji
message: （…But, with Setsugekka...）
Maybe, it might actually be possible.
Suddenly, I felt like calculating the probability of that coming true.

name: Momiji
message: （…No, stop that, that’s so unrefined.）
Perhaps I was just afraid of knowing the result.
So for now... I’ll just try believing in Setsugekka’s words.
